Name: Joha, Brother of Jediael
Summary: Brother of Jediael, son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:45: Brother of Jediael, son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joha in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
